source_doc.title: primetrading Substack: Equity Research Deep Dive — Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI), 800G inflection and AI infrastructure cycle
source_doc.permission_basis: Independent analyst newsletter (free post); only brief quotations for research are stored in library/raw and this extraction.

sources.quote: the company achieved its fourth major 800G volume order from a hyperscale customer during the quarter
The data center customers are widely understood to be Microsoft and Amazon
broke ground on a new 210,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Sugar Land, Texas
Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) for semiconductor laser manufacturing
less than 10% of the value in its 800G/1.6T modules currently originates from China

claims.statement: AAOI secured its fourth major 800G volume order from a hyperscale customer in the quarter, and demand for its 800G/1.6T products currently exceeds production capabilities through mid-2027 (analyst assessment).
claims.disproof_condition: Order cancellations or quarterly results showing utilization below capacity / inventory build.

claims.statement: AAOI's hyperscale data-center customers are widely understood to be Microsoft and Amazon (analyst inference, NOT company disclosure — do not create named-customer edges without customer-side or filing confirmation).
claims.disproof_condition: Company filings or customer-side documents identify a different customer set.

claims.statement: AAOI's manufacturing moat rests on vertically integrated MBE-based laser production (vs competitors' MOCVD) and US onshoring: less than 10% of the value in its 800G/1.6T modules currently originates from China — low direct exposure to China InP export-control risk relative to peers.
claims.disproof_condition: Supply-chain disclosures show materially higher China-origin value content, or MBE yields/economics prove uncompetitive vs MOCVD at volume.
